He bought a HOUSE for his mother, one for his father and one for his grandmother. What’s wrong with that? Absolutely nothing. That’s something to be proud of. Thank you, Lamine. 🚨🎙️| Cubarsí: "When you’re young, awards like the Golden Boy or the Kopa trophy are DREAMS and I am so pleased to have won this one now, it means our season with Barca and Spain was very good, but also that I am on the RIGHT track.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Cubarsí: “Us defenders are not too eye-catching. People PREFER strikers or wingers, or anyone who scores and assists and I get it. The ones who play in defence do more of the DIRTY work. I would like to see our roles a bit more RECOGNISED. Not for me, but to see any defender getting the plaudits they deserve, because we do a very important job.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Cubarsí: “When I was a kid, I looked up to Carles Puyol, My role models are Puyol and Gerard Pique. I like both profiles the gritty defender and the ball playing one. Pique played more of a role in the build-up, but Puyol was key in terms of mentality and character.
I have looked up a lot to Virgil van Dijk in recent years." #fcblive

🚨 THE DOUBLE STANDARD SURROUNDING BARÇA ATLÈTIC IS A DISGRACE — AND WE NEED TO TALK ABOUT IT.

Barça Atlètic were forced to face Girona B yesterday despite having only 10 registered reserve-team players available, with 21 absences!!! The RFEF REJECTED Barça's request to postpone the match, despite comparable precedents involving Real Madrid Castilla.

In September 2025, RM Castilla had their match against Racing de Ferrol postponed after being reduced to just 10 available players. The federation accepted their request.

Barça, meanwhile, were told to play. And the consequences were there for everyone to see. Barça Atlètic lost 1-0, but the result was only part of the damage. Dani Ávila was forced off injured before the fifth minute, Ibrahim Diarra lasted just 10 minutes before suffering an injury, while Hafiz Gariba and Juwensley Onstein also finished with physical problems. Diarra even left the pitch in tears, and Barça were left playing with 10 men.

How can the same federation reach such different decisions in situations involving similar squad shortages? This isn't about asking for special treatment. It's about demanding equal treatment.

The rules must apply equally to every club. The inconsistency is unacceptable, and this controversy deserves far more attention. #fcblive 🔴
